testcase.name: Rule: Dockable Properties commands reuse the Properties shell: Scenario: Apply and start another feature: mnt/vininas-projects/MCAD-Scenarios/features/solid-model/feature-properties/feature-properties.feature:112:5
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Apply and start another feature ✔ Given a feature Properties panel has a valid preview in a disposable part ✔ When the user clicks Apply and create new in the footer ✔ Then the current feature is committed once and appears in the model browser ✔ And Properties stays open for another feature with the carried configuration and fresh input requirements ✔ When the user cancels the second feature ✔ Then the first feature remains committed and no second feature is added
